competences.description: Attacks all enemies. The damage dealt increases by 20% for each harmful effect granted on the target.
Attacks all enemies 6 times. Each of the first 5 hits replaces 1 beneficial effect granted on them with Continuous Damage for 2 turns with a 20% chance.
Increases the boss's Attack Power and Defense for 2 turns at the start of its turn and gains immunity against Attack Bar decreasing effects. [Automatic Effect]
When the boss is attacked, inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns to the enemy that attacked the boss. [Automatic Effect]
